summary_1line: Arjuna spares Ashwatthaman, Bhima duels Duryodhana, Abhimanyu devastates Kaurava princes, Bhishma slaughters Pandava troops, and Satyaki unleashes a deadly assault before facing Bhurisravas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima draws his bow to his ear and drives ten arrows deep into Duryodhana’s chest as the golden gem on the king’s breast gleams among the shafts.
Abhimanyu, blood-covered yet radiant, cuts down Lakshmana’s horses and charioteer as princes surround him like a ring around a blazing fire.
Satyaki stands on his chariot loosing arrows so rapidly that he appears like a storm cloud pouring a torrential rain of shafts upon ten thousand chariots.
